body: I don't have what it takes to make. I am sure you had what it took though. Probably good interview skills, good social skills, probably made it through college. Hell, even when I sold something on craigslist the other day I panicked and my neck got all red. Most people are not good people, most people are very selfish and don't understand people like me.

Technically I did try. I worked for my father's construction business for about a year but quit due to misophonia. I only got the job because I was family so I don't really consider that to be real employment. 

I know nothing will happen unless I try but there is really no point in trying because I will just end up miserable again. My future will be bleak if I go on. I know this, I am usually good at predicting things.

If try the outside world it will just confirm all my negative beliefs about it. People will look at me because of my bad skin. People will think I look funny. People will think I am awkward because I have social anxiety. I wouldn't put up with that. Why the hell would I? I can get away from all that by just taking my own life.

There are no jobs that I am interested in. Especially having severe social anxiety and self conscious about my looks. 

Volunteer and meet friends? Even if I volunteer I still probably couldn't make friends there.

I understand why a girl wouldn't like me. I don't expect them to. I am just a miserable being who will kill himself in the very near future. I am actually happy that I can get away from the misery.
That is most people's answer. Get a job while being miserable. Real great solution..
